items.title: Kalshi: Fed decision in October?
items.claim: At pool access time 19:04 UTC on September 23, the direct page displayed 66% for Hike 25bps, 32% for Fed maintains rate, and 2% for Hike >25bps.

items.title: Polymarket: Fed Decision in October?
items.claim: At pool access time 19:04 UTC on September 23, the direct page displayed 68% for a 25 bp increase and 33% for no change; its rules use the upper-bound target-range change and name the October FOMC statement as resolution source.

items.title: CME FedWatch
items.claim: CME describes FedWatch as probabilities implied by 30-Day Fed Funds futures, but the direct live October grid was unreadable in this check.

items.title: Federal Reserve October 2026 calendar
items.claim: The calendar lists September meeting minutes on October 7 at 14:00 ET and the October 27–28 meeting, statement at 14:00 ET and press conference at 14:30 ET on October 28.

items.title: BEA 26-32
items.claim: The notice schedules U.S. International Transactions and Investment Position for the second quarter of 2026 on September 24 at 08:30 ET.

items.title: BLS Current Population Survey
items.claim: The page schedules the Employment Situation for September 2026 on October 2 at 08:30 ET.
